environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium). The application runs as root user. ACTIVE_API_KEY is set via environment variable and rotated manually by ops team (typically monthly). Uploads directory is served directly by Express static middleware. No reverse proxy or WAF in front. Security group allows inbound 4000/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. The uploads directory is on the same EBS volume as the application code.
